mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_ai_group_memory_candidate ( customer_id, group_id, memory_type, memory_key, normalized_key, normalized_value, polarity, memory_content, confidence_score, worthiness_score, status, lifecycle_status, decision_reason_code, hit_count, source_count, evidence_count, source_message, last_seen_at, last_reinforced_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, confirmed_memory_id ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{groupId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{normalizedKey}, #{normalizedValue}, #{polarity}, #{memoryContent}, #{confidenceScore}, #{worthinessScore}, #{status}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{decisionReasonCode}, #{hitCount}, #{sourceCount}, #{evidenceCount}, #{sourceMessage}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{lastReinforcedAt}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{confirmedMemoryId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE b_ai_group_memory_candidate SET status = #{status}, lifecycle_status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, confirmed_memory_id = #{confirmedMemoryId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE b_ai_group_memory_candidate SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, source_count = source_count + 1, evidence_count = evidence_count + 1, confidence_score = #{confidenceScore}, worthiness_score = #{worthinessScore}, decision_reason_code = #{decisionReasonCode}, source_message = #{sourceMessage}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, last_reinforced_at = #{lastReinforcedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b_ai_group_memory_candidate WHERE status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'CONFLICT') AND last_seen_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{staleHours} HOUR)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, last_seen_at, NOW())), 0) FROM b_ai_group_memory_candidate WHERE status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'CONFLICT')
